levels.surface: محمد ابن عيسى بن عبيد اليقطيني

notes: The report number «27-1» carries the chapter number; «أبي» at the head is the compiler's father, a relation link
«عن جده الحسن بن راشد» is one link: «جده» plus a name is written as the name alone (rule 7)
The Imam Sadiq is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator; the Imam Ali named in the relayed words is the last link (owner ruling 2)
